verdict_reason: For a PSD unit-diagonal kernel BLME computes exp(-sum lambda_i log lambda_i) from eigenvalues of K/n exactly as Friedman and Dieng define it. A fresh random cosine cloud matched official score_K bit-for-bit, while K=I_7 and the all-identical kernel returned 7.0 and 1.0 to floating roundoff; no value-changing counterexample was found on the paper-defined domain.
comparable_reason: At the fixed 512-point cap, vendi_overall_mean is empirically clean across 66 models (rho=+0.074 with d_model, p=0.557; -0.052 with n_layers, p=0.678; -0.197 with vocabulary, p=0.113). The emitted endpoints are not: first-layer Vendi has rho=-0.339 with width (p=0.0054) and -0.321 with depth (p=0.0087), while last-layer Vendi has rho=+0.319 (p=0.0091) and +0.380 (p=0.0016), so only the overall/profile-central summaries are cross-model defensible.
github_reason: Fetched the released implementation and ran vendi-score 0.0.3. On the fresh 31x9 cloud BLME and official score_K returned exactly 7.843440193473708; previous direct score_X checks on clean nonzero clouds at shapes (40,16), (200,64), and (512,768) differed by at most 2.25e-15 relative, and duplicated-row inputs also agreed.
paper_reason: The paper states VS=n for n mutually dissimilar samples and VS=1 for identical samples. BLME returned 6.999999999999998 for K=I_7 (relative error 2.54e-16) and 1.000000000000007 for seven identical rows (relative error 7.11e-15).
confounds_reason: The primary overall mean has no detected architecture correlation, but the task emits endpoint and slope/extreme summaries whose post-final-normalization behavior is architecture-family dependent; first and last fields have significant, oppositely signed width/depth correlations in the 66-model table. Thus confounding is field-specific rather than a failure of the Vendi formula.
defects: COMPARABILITY: vendi_mean_first_layer and vendi_mean_last_layer are significantly architecture-associated even though vendi_overall_mean is clean; reporting one task-wide value without naming the field would be misleading.
CONFIG max_points=512 changes the estimand rather than merely approximating it: 1,000 mutually orthogonal samples have source VS=1,000 but the task can report at most 512.

_meta_vendi_normalized_mean divides every capped score by the same 512 in ordinary runs and therefore preserves every architecture correlation exactly; its _meta_ prefix correctly keeps it out of the feature matrix, but it is not a successful architecture normalization.

DOC the module/class and task_metadata still describe default cosine as nonlinear and still advertise the withdrawn vendi_null_ratio_mean; cosine here is the linear Gram kernel of row-normalized features and that output no longer exists.

The all-zero extension is reasonable and satisfies the unit-diagonal definition, but official score_X reaches 1.0 by a different sub-probability-spectrum route; cosine similarity itself is undefined at a zero vector, and no exactly zero hidden-state rows were found in the real-model checks.
